_help: Quiz for Roles in Web3, Explained. 5 to 8 questions. answer must match one of the options exactly. explain is shown after the quiz. This folder is never shown to visitors.

questions.question: What does a smart contract engineer write?
options: Code that runs on the blockchain and often holds money
questions.answer: Code that runs on the blockchain and often holds money
questions.explain: Because contract code can hold real money, careful testing and audits are part of the job.

questions.question: What does a security auditor do?
options: Reviews smart contract code for bugs
questions.answer: Reviews smart contract code for bugs
questions.explain: Audits and bug bounties catch costly mistakes before attackers do.

questions.question: What is developer relations (DevRel)?
options: Helping other builders use the product with docs, tutorials and hackathons
questions.answer: Helping other builders use the product with docs, tutorials and hackathons
questions.explain: DevRel sits between the product and the developers who build on it.

questions.question: Which role runs the project's chats, welcomes newcomers and keeps scammers out?
questions.explain: It is one of the most common first jobs in web3.

questions.question: Which of these is a red flag in a web3 job offer?
options: You must pay a fee to get the job
They ask for links to your past work
questions.answer: You must pay a fee to get the job
questions.explain: Real jobs never charge you. Also never run unknown files a recruiter sends you.

questions.question: What is often the best way to show you can do a web3 job?
options: Public work you have already done, like a guide or community help
A long CV with no links
questions.answer: Public work you have already done, like a guide or community help
questions.explain: In web3, a link to real work usually matters more than a CV line.
